biotools.summary: Xena is a web-based tool for exploring public and private multi-omic and clinical data from the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and other sources. It allows users to compare tumor samples, investigate correlations between gene expression and epigenetic modifications, and analyze immunotherapy responses.
